content:
Nina (CSM): Heads-up: LuminaPress flagged as yellow -> renewal in 14 days. DAU steady but token consumption for embeddings dropped ~60% last 2 weeks. They reported 'no results' from semantic search after a content ingestion job.
Ravi (Solutions): Do we know if they switched vector DBs or changed embedding model? Any recent config changes?
Nina (CSM): They upgraded their pipeline to v2.1 two weeks ago. Support ticket shows 422s from the embed endpoint and a couple of timeout retries. They're on Hosted API with a mid-market tier.
Jo (Enablement): Short remediation play: 30m triage + 30m enablement session with their SREs to validate payload shapes and rate limits. I can prep a one-slide cheat sheet for their engineers.
Priya (AM): If we don't show quick progress, renewal will be contentious. Propose a 2-part offer: technical rescue + 30% credit on next invoice contingent on measured recovery.
Ravi (Solutions): I can run a rapid health check now. Asking for: sample failing payload, response headers, and their current model id.
Nina (CSM): Pasting sanitized payload and headers below. Also adding contact: "Eli (Platform)", "Maya (Eng)".
---
Sanitized payload snippet:
```
{
  "input": "...",
  "metadata": {"source": "cms", "version": "v2.1"},
  "model": "open-embed-2-small"
}
```
Response snippet: 422 Unprocessable Entity - "invalid metadata schema"
---
Ravi (Solutions): That metadata schema mismatch explains it. Quick fix: strip unknown top-level metadata keys or map them via a pre-ingest transform. I can share a 6-line python shim.
Jo (Enablement): I'll run a 45-min hands-on at their timezone Thu 9am local. I'll include the pre-ingest transform snippet + an automated validation script.
Priya (AM): For the commercial angle, let's frame the credit as an "uptime recovery credit" tied to restoration of search results to baseline. Sends a signal of partnership without immediate price change.
ops-bot: Created watch: LuminaPress-INGEST-RECOVERY. Alert: embed-error-rate > 5% triggers paging.
Ravi (Solutions): Taking triage. @Nina please add the request id from latest failed call. Also confirm whether they use batching in the ingestion job.
Nina (CSM): Added request id and confirmed batching = yes, batch size ~256.
Ravi (Solutions): If batch size 256 -> risk of intermittent 422s when a single bad record present. Recommend temp lower batch size to 16 and enable per-item validation while we patch.
Jo (Enablement): I'll include that in the lab doc and record a 5-min clip of how to toggle batch size and validate locally.
Priya (AM): I'll draft the renewal communication. Plan: offer recovery credit, schedule CTO-level call if not recovered in 7 days.
Nina (CSM): Action list:
- Ravi: triage + sample shim + recommend batch-size change (ETA 24h)
- Jo: enablement lab + validation recording (ETA 48h)
- Priya: comms + conditional credit template (ETA 24h)
- Nina: update CRM and open 7-day follow-up task
Please react with :white_check_mark: when you accept.
Ravi (Solutions): :white_check_mark: starting triage now.
Jo (Enablement): :white_check_mark: prepping lab materials.
Priya (AM): :white_check_mark: drafting comms.
Nina (CSM): Thanks team — will loop in customer for Thu slot and keep ops-bot on.
